content: 1. Maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription medications, over-the-counter drugs, and herbal supplements. Share this list with your doctor and pharmacist to ensure safe and effective treatment. 2. Be aware that this medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, potentially leading to inaccurate results. Inform your healthcare provider and laboratory personnel about your medication use. 3. In the event of an overdose, this medication can be harmful if ingested. If someone experiences severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. For non-emergency situations, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. 4. Regular physical examinations, including laboratory and medical tests such as blood pressure monitoring, breast exams/mammograms, pelvic exams, and Pap smears, are recommended while using this medication. Follow your doctor’s instructions for self-examination of your breasts and report any abnormalities, such as lumps, promptly. 5. Attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments to monitor your health and the effects of the medication. 6. Managing or preventing high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and diabetes can significantly reduce your risk of heart disease and stroke. Lifestyle modifications such as stress reduction, a low-fat/low-salt diet, weight loss if overweight, regular exercise, and smoking cessation are highly beneficial. 7. Engage in mental exercises, such as reading or solving crossword puzzles, to help maintain cognitive function and potentially prevent dementia. 8. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not remove the ring from its pouch until you are ready to use it. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into drains unless specifically instructed to do so. Dispose of expired or unused medication properly. 9. This document provides a summary of information about the medication and does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized medical advice. 10. Before using estradiol, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 11. Avoid smoking or using tobacco products while on this medication, as it increases the risk of blood clots, especially when using estrogen-containing products. 12. Inform your doctor if you have recently undergone surgery, are planning surgery, or will be immobile for an extended period (e.g., during a long flight), as these conditions elevate the risk of blood clots. 13. This medication may cause melasma, which appears as blotchy, dark areas on the skin or face. Sunlight can exacerbate this condition. Limit sun exposure, avoid tanning booths and sunlamps, and use sunscreen or protective clothing when outdoors. 14. If you are nearsighted or wear contact lenses, you may experience vision problems or difficulty wearing your lenses while using this medication. Consult your doctor if these issues arise. 15. If you develop a vaginal infection while using this medication, you may leave the ring in place during treatment for the infection. 16. This medication should not be used during pregnancy. It can pass into breast milk and may reduce the quality and quantity of milk production. Consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. 17. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a detailed list of all products you use and share it with your healthcare provider to avoid potential interactions. 18. Adding plans to your formulary comparison allows you to evaluate the status of this medication relative to others in the same class. Contact your plan provider for the most up-to-date formulary information. 19. When sharing information about this medication with others, ensure you have permission to do so.
